title: Implement spell checking
line: Sticky notes now underline misspelled words and offer spelling suggestions in their right-click menu.
explanation: The Sticky Note widget uses Plasma's own TextArea, which, unlike the desktop-style TextArea used by apps, has no Sonnet spell checking, so the system spell check setting had no effect in notes. Its custom right-click menu also had no place for suggestions. The change attaches a Sonnet SpellcheckHighlighter to the note's text when the system "spell checking enabled by default" setting is on, and adds suggestions, Add to Dictionary and Ignore at the top of the note's context menu when right-clicking a misspelled word.

commits.message:
applets/notes: add spell checking

The note's text area had no spell checking, unlike other text fields that
follow the system spell check setting. Misspelled words are now underlined
when that setting is on, with suggestions, Add to Dictionary and Ignore.

BUG: 510606

media.caption: Spell checking is enabled in the system settings, but misspelled words in a note are not marked.
Misspelled words are underlined in red.
Right-clicking a misspelled word shows only the editing actions.
Right-clicking a misspelled word offers suggestions, Add to Dictionary and Ignore above the usual actions.
